## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the blue-capped plastic bottle and shake it.

Task description: The target is the transparent plastic bottle lying horizontally at the front left of the table, with a blue cap. Pick it up and shake it.

Success criteria: The target bottle has been grasped and shaken, and remains clearly suspended above the table at completion.

## Execution tips

- Approach the relatively straight middle section of the bottle from above, with the closing direction across its long axis where possible. Avoid the cap and sloped shoulder to reduce slipping while shaking.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the selected grasp section. Before closing, confirm that both fingers are on opposite sides of the bottle and the pads can make contact, rather than pressing only on top or against the table.
- Test-lift slightly to check whether the bottle body slips. If it needs to be grasped again, first let the body rest on the table rather than releasing it while suspended.
- Shake with moderate-amplitude back-and-forth motion and smooth reversals in open space above the table front. Leave swing clearance for cap and bottom, avoiding the tabletop, upright bottle, and black round object behind.
